build_lexicon_graph: build a graph that transduces letters to word pieces using a lexicon and letter-to-index mapping
build_token_graph: build a graph with individual token transition models for consuming one or more consecutive word pieces
compute_word_decomposition: compute the decomposition graph for a word by composing its letter graph with a lexicon graph
compute_alignment_graph: compute the alignment graph for a word by composing the token graph with its decomposition graph
compute_sequence_loss: compute the sequence level loss by subtracting the forward score of intersected emissions from the forward score
